hooks.command: powershell -NonInteractive -Command "$json = $input | Out-String | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $json.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -and ($f -match '\.(ts|tsx)$') -and ($f -match 'frontend[\\/]')) { $rel = $f -replace [regex]::Escape((Get-Location).Path + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar), ''; Write-Host \"[hook] TypeScript check: $rel\"; $result = & npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 10; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $result | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }; exit 0 } } "

powershell -NonInteractive -Command "$json = $input | Out-String | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $json.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -and ($f -match '\.(ts|tsx|js)$') -and ($f -match 'frontend[\\/]')) { $rel = $f -replace [regex]::Escape((Get-Location).Path + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar), ''; Write-Host \"[hook] ESLint: $rel\"; npx eslint --max-warnings 0 $f 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 8 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ } }"
